title: FinRL-DeepSeek: LLM-Infused Risk-Sensitive Reinforcement Learning for Trading Agents

task.value: Building a risk-sensitive stock trading agent that combines reinforcement learning (CVaR-PPO) with LLM-generated trading recommendations and risk scores from financial news.
task.quote: We extend the Conditional Value-at-Risk Proximal Policy Optimization (CPPO) algorithm, by adding risk assessment and trading recommendation signals generated by a LLM from financial news.

architecture.value: LLM scores news per stock/day into recommendation (1-5) and risk (1-5) scores; recommendation scores multiply PPO actions (S_f near 1), and portfolio-weighted risk scores R_f rescale trajectory returns in CVaR-PPO.
architecture.quote: At the end, financial news influence trading actions in two ways: through S_{f} and R_{f} .

data.value: FNSPID financial news (15.7 million records, 1999–2023), subsampled to one article per stock per day (2 million records); Nasdaq-100 stocks, daily.
data.quote: We use the FNSPID dataset (Dong et al., 2024), which contains 15.7 million time-aligned financial news records spanning 1999–2023. To reduce LLM API costs, we randomly select a representative news article per stock per day, reducing the dataset to 2 million records.

window.value: Two setups: train 2019–2022, trade 2023; and train 2013–2018, trade 2019-2023. Windows for the 2M-step runs are not stated in text.
window.quote:
Training Period: 2013–2018
Training Iterations: 400k steps (20 epochs, 20k steps each)
Trading Period: 2019-2023

models.value: DeepSeek V3, Qwen 2.5 72B and Llama 3.3 70B for news scoring; PPO and CVaR-PPO RL agents.
models.quote: Using LLMs (DeepSeek V3 (DeepSeek-AI et al., 2024), Qwen 2.5 72B (Qwen et al., 2025) Llama 3.3 70B (Grattafiori et al., 2024)), we extract stock recommendations and risk assessment using the following prompts :

baselines.value: Plain PPO and CPPO without LLM signals, and the Nasdaq 100 benchmark.
baselines.quote: In these two runs (RL agents are stochastic), PPO and CPPO-DeepSeek outperform other methods, including the Nasdaq 100 benchmark.

headline_result.value: After 2 million training steps, CPPO-DeepSeek (10%) achieved Information Ratio 0.0078, CVaR -0.0437, Rachev Ratio 0.9818, versus CPPO -0.0148, -0.0439, 1.0404.

costs.value: Only inference-cost consideration: news subsampled to one article per stock per day to reduce LLM API costs. No transaction cost assumptions stated.
costs.quote: To reduce LLM API costs, we randomly select a representative news article per stock per day, reducing the dataset to 2 million records.

uncertainty.value: Two runs of the 2-million-step training reported, noting RL agents are stochastic; no confidence intervals or significance tests stated.
uncertainty.quote: In these two runs (RL agents are stochastic), PPO and CPPO-DeepSeek outperform other methods, including the Nasdaq 100 benchmark.

limitations.value: High RAM requirements for longer training (128 GB for 2M steps), daily timescale may be too slow, and news signal quality from FNSPID needs improvement; LLM infusion sometimes worsens performance.
limitations.quote: Optimizing RAM usage: Longer training requires more RAM. For instance, 500k training steps used 16 GB (+Swap memory), whereas 2 million steps required 128 GB (+Swap memory). Optimizing memory efficiency is crucial for scalability.

release.value: Code, data and trading agents released on GitHub.
release.quote: The code, data, and trading agents are available at: https://github.com/benstaf/FinRL_DeepSeek
